basis: Node.js Runtime text-tier invocation. Callers address operations by qualified domain and name. The shared Code interpreter handles a registered operation's typed request.

cases.claim: A bare operation name is refused at the text-tier boundary.
cases.test: refuses an unnamespaced operationId before it ever reaches content-engine dispatch

cases.claim: The text tier can dispatch operations in two domains by their qualified names.
cases.test: namespaces two domains without collision and dispatches by qualified id

cases.claim: An installed consumer invokes a named text operation and receives its typed result.
